description: This file contains a Java implementation of a renderer for rendering a rotating textured triangle using OpenGL ES 2.0 in Android. It implements the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface, defines shader programs, manages texture loading, and performs drawing operations.

classes.name: GLES20TriangleRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that renders a textured, rotating triangle on an OpenGL ES 2.0 surface in Android.

methods.name: GLES20TriangleRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with context and setting up vertex buffers.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Per-frame rendering method that clears the screen, sets up the shader program, binds textures, updates rotation, and draws the triangle.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in surface size, adjusts the viewport, and projection matrix accordingly.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes shaders, program, attributes, uniforms, textures, and matrices when the surface is created.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of a given type with provided source code.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Links vertex and fragment shaders into an OpenGL program.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws an exception if any are found.
